scope: Windows Tk product panel interaction checks using synthetic files and mocked maintenance effects

environment.tk_interpreter_lifecycle: One Tk interpreter per test module, matching the real settings application

limitations: This checks actual Tk geometry and scripted interactions; it is not full manual visual acceptance at all DPI settings.
Maintenance filesystem effects are mocked here; maintenance/upgrade tests and installation evidence cover their backend behavior separately.
Real application integration, native release packaging and DSH answer quality are tracked separately.
